verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Up on the mountain
Or down in the valley low
You have my heart
Up on the mountain
Or down in the valley low
You have my heart

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
And this I know, with my hand in Yours
You will lead me over the mountain
Through the valley to Your fountains
That never run dry

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You have won my heart
You have won my heart
You have won my heart

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Through every trial and tribulation
Of this journey of my soul
Come be the vision
That holds my eyes up to Your throne

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Up on the mountain
Or down in the valley low
You have my heart

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
In every season of my life, Lord
I will respond with love for You
Though there be testing, though there be trials
I will respond with love for You

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
In every season of my life, Lord
Help me respond with love for You
Though there be testing, though there be trials
Help me respond with love for You
